text:
Nina (Growth): Quick sync: publishing webinar landing + three posts tomorrow. Need final SEO checklist: keywords, JSON-LD for event + FAQ where useful, internal anchor plan, and simple redirects for old /events and /webinars slugs. Can we triage?
Ravi (SEO): Ill do keyword mapping: 3 targets per page (primary short, supporting, longtail) and label intent. Will update the sheet.
Jules (Content): Drafts uploaded. Adding 160-char metas and OG images. Recommend FAQ schema on recap.
Sam (Web): For SSR pages we'll inject JSON-LD in head. For client-side routes we should prerender. Example event JSON-LD: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-06-10T18:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms"}
seo-bot: Audit: duplicate meta between landing and post1; missing H1 on post2. Re-scan after updates.
Ravi (SEO): Internal linking plan: landing -> /product/inference (anchor variants: "LLM inference platform", "high-throughput inference", "reduce token costs"), benchmark -> /benchmarks, recap -> /resources/webinars (three anchors each).
Jules (Content): Old slug list in the sheet. Marking duplicates for 301. For evergreen posts keep separate canonical tags.
Sam (Web): I'll implement nginx 301s that preserve querystrings: use return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/new-slug?$query_string; Will whitelist slugs to avoid accidental chains. Also will add sitemap entries (priority 0.8) and CDN invalidation for OG images post-deploy.
Nina (Growth): Owners/deadlines: Jules (final copy + metas + slug decisions by 4pm PT), Ravi (keywords + anchors by 4pm), Sam (redirects + JSON-LD placement tomorrow AM), seo-bot will do final scan after staging. Ping me if blockers. Thanks!
